text:
Maya: Heads-up — noticed a cluster of accounts where onboarding.start_date and contact.phone are missing. Healthscore is treating them as cold, but manual checks show most have active trials. Wondering if we should apply a sparsity heuristic before the playbook runs.
Priya: Can you paste a quick sample of affected rows? Might be a sync gap from the onboarding webhook.
Maya: Example: account_id=AC-1123 user_count=4 onboarding.start_date=null last_activity=2024-11-02 tags=[trial]. There are ~420 accounts like this in last 30d.
Alex: Ugh, that explains the false negatives on renewal risk alerts.
Jon: Two immediate questions: (1) can we infer start_date from first event in telemetry? (2) do we want a temporary playbook override to prevent auto-escalation?
Maya: For (1) yes, telemetry.first_session_timestamp exists for ~85% of these. For the rest, maybe infer from crm.import_date. For (2) I'd prefer a safe fallback: mark healthscore as "needs manual review" instead of lowering.
Priya: I can write an imputation SQL and add a flag column `health_imputed` so we can track. Proposed rule: if onboarding.start_date is null and telemetry.first_session_timestamp is not null and < 60 days ago => set onboarding.start_date = telemetry.first_session_timestamp and mark health_imputed=true.
Alex: That sounds reasonable. Also we should exclude accounts with `trial_status = 'inactive'` to avoid false positives.
Maya: Agreed. Can we add a short playbook step that checks health_imputed and routes to a light-touch outbound sequence instead of immediate renewal owner ping?
Jon: Yes — update playbook rule priority: imputed=true => route to "CS triage" queue with low urgency. No owner escalation until manual confirm.
Priya: SQL draft:
```
UPDATE crm.accounts a
SET onboarding_start_date = t.first_session_ts,
    health_imputed = 'true',
    impute_source = 'telemetry'
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, min(event_ts) as first_session_ts
  FROM telemetry.sessions
  WHERE event_ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
  GROUP BY account_id
) t
WHERE a.account_id = t.account_id
  AND a.onboarding_start_date IS NULL
  AND a.trial_status != 'inactive';
```
Priya: Also a quick check to surface samples before commit:
```
SELECT a.account_id, a.onboarding_start_date, t.first_session_ts, a.trial_status
FROM crm.accounts a
JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, min(event_ts) as first_session_ts
  FROM telemetry.sessions
  WHERE event_ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
  GROUP BY account_id
) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.onboarding_start_date IS NULL
LIMIT 20;
```
Alex: Nice. Can we run the SELECT and post sample rows in #private-cs-ops for a quick eyeball? I can QA tomorrow morning.
Maya: I'll run the SELECT and dump CSV to the ops drive. Also thinking about automating a small pre-playbook sanitizer lambda that runs nightly and toggles the `health_imputed` flag. That way playbooks see cleaned data.
Jon: Ops note: add a conservative time-to-live for imputed flags (e.g., 30 days) so they don't persist forever without confirmation.
Priya: I'll add a `impute_expires_at` column set to now() + interval '30 days' on update. Also will write a small SQL to revert imputed values older than 30d where no manual confirmation exists.
CS-bot: Scheduled job created: crm.impute_sanitizer -> nightly @ 03:00 UTC (pending Priya deploy).
Maya: Canary plan: run imputation on a random 10% sample of affected accounts (approx 42 accounts) for 48h, route those to CS triage, monitor renewal-check alerts and owner pings.
Alex: Metrics to watch: number of false escalation alerts, manual confirmations, and any change in NPS for canary cohort (if available). Also monitor playbook run count.
Jon: Owner assignments: Priya -> write and test SQL + sanitizer job. Maya -> run SELECT, prepare sample CSV, coordinate canary. Alex -> QA playbook routing changes. I'll update the playbook config once we confirm the SQL produces sane samples.
Maya: Cool. I'll post the CSV link here when done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya: Will post a PR and link to the sanitizer job logs. ETA for PR: EOD today.
Alex: :raised_hands: Good plan.
Maya: Follow-up: if anyone sees accounts that look wrong, ping me directly with account_id. We should avoid any mass bad imputes.
Jon: Agreed. Post-rollout retro next week.
